subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/diagnostic-runtime` gain a public `onModelDiagnosticEvent` hook for the trusted model diagnostic event allowlist in this PR?
rationale: The implementation changes a public plugin SDK subpath and establishes a new event delivery contract, which is a maintainer API direction choice beyond a mechanical CI fix.

options.title: Accept the narrow SDK hook
options.body: Keep this PR's diagnostic-runtime API shape and require the surface budget/API artifacts to be updated before merge.

options.title: Route through a different usage seam
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if maintainers prefer provider-scoped model usage or a future durable usage ledger rather than exposing trusted model diagnostics through this SDK subpath.

options.title: Delay until broader usage work lands
options.body: Keep the hook out of the SDK for now and let broader model usage accounting work define the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow SDK hook
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's diagnostic-runtime API shape and require the surface budget/API artifacts to be updated before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent diagnostics and model-call telemetry history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the API direction.
